shared_elements: animal heads in profile facing one direction
relief carving with figures set against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces show quadrupeds in strict profile arranged in horizontal registers, and both stack repeated animal figures in a row, but that is a very generic correspondence. A shows schematic, disproportionate animals, birds and reptilian creatures with no human figures and no framing ornament, while B shows naturalistic horned rams led by human attendants above a rosette border — different creatures, different relationships (herding/leading versus isolated schematic beasts) and quite different rendering conventions.
